# Noobot v4.1.8

This release establishes unified execution isolation rules, optimizes the codebase and configuration system, and adds a reusable model library.

## Highlights

- Established explicit execution isolation rules for workspace, host, sandbox, and native tool execution.
- Optimized code structure, runtime behavior, and cross-tool resource handling.
- Improved configuration defaults, migration, validation, and desktop synchronization.
- Added a model library for consistent model discovery and configuration.
